svg.title: Bandwidth per added connection. PurrNet used 27% less additional downstream bandwidth per connection than FishNet, from 10 to 100 connections. NetworkTransform + SyncVars + RPCs + spawn/despawn, 10 → 100 connections, 20 Hz.

cc:Work.dc:title: Bandwidth per added connection. PurrNet used 27% less additional downstream bandwidth per connection than FishNet, from 10 to 100 connections. NetworkTransform + SyncVars + RPCs + spawn/despawn, 10 → 100 connections, 20 Hz.
cc:Work.dc:description: Mean across six load tests of (server downstream at 100 connections − at 10) / 90, at 20 Hz. 1 KiB = 1,024 bytes. Observed marginal cost over this interval; not a per-player total or a projection. One run; no repeat variability measured. Fusion uses Photon relay.
